set.body: Evidence: FunctionalKind and PenaltyTerm, GlrmFactorPenalty, BlockStructuredPenaltyKind and evidence IR repeat L1 and smoothness concepts without an explicit ownership map. Acceptance: define one stable identity for shared mathematical functionals with family-specific capability witnesses and targets; provide total runtime-to-evidence mappings; document which penalties are genuinely family-specific; add exhaustiveness and round-trip tests without weakening current lowering checks.
set.title: Define one cross-family penalty functional identity
